'''Guillermo "Willy" Hernangómez Geuer'''<ref>{{cite web|title=Guillermo Hernangómez Geuer|url=http://www.scoresway.com/?sport=basketball&page=player&id=10779|website=''Scoresway.com''|accessdate=25 April 2015}}</ref> (born May 27, 1994) is a Spanish professional [[basketball]] player who currently plays for [[CB Sevilla|Baloncesto Sevilla]] of the [[Liga ACB]], on loan from [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]].<ref name=profile>{{cite web|title=Willy Hernangomez Player Profile|url=http://basketball.realgm.com/player/Guillermo-Hernangomez/Summary/37870|website=''[[RealGM]]''|accessdate=25 April 2015}}</ref> On April 24, 2015, he entered the [[2015 NBA draft]] as a potential second-round selection.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Trapani|first1=E.|title=Guillermo Hernangomez will enter the Draft|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/159348/guillermo-hernangomez-will-enter-the-draft.html|website=''Sportando.com''|accessdate=25 April 2015}}</ref>

==Professional career==
Considered one of the most important prospects of [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]], Hernangómez played his first pro seasons at its [[Real Madrid Baloncesto B|reserve team]]. On summer 2013, Hernangómez was loaned to [[CB Sevilla|Cajasol Sevilla]], extending his agreement for one more season in the next summer.
